items: PDF support — import and read PDF files with page-accurate progress tracking
PDF metadata extraction (title, author, page count, reading time estimate)
Books are now stored with their correct file extension (.epub, .pdf, .mobi)
About page with app info, changelog, and links
Mobile navigation menu for settings, insights, and about
Invalid EPUB/MOBI files are rejected on import with a clear error
Unsupported file formats now fail gracefully
Per-book progress, bookmarks, and reading streaks
Font, size, line height, and theme controls
All data stored locally via Capacitor Preferences
